EmailTemplate.description: Sent to a channel partner's contact when the CP Manager approves the registration: the temporary Partner Portal access and its dates.
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Access Approved
EmailTemplate.subject: Your John Keells Properties Partner Portal access is approved
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.Name},
Your channel partner registration for {!Account.Name} has been approved by John Keells Properties.
You now have temporary access to the John Keells Properties Partner Portal from {!Account.Temporary_Access_Start_Date__c} to {!Account.Temporary_Access_End_Date__c}.
HOW TO BECOME AN EXCLUSIVE CHANNEL PARTNER One of these must happen before your access ends: - one of your leads becomes a customer, or - 3 site visits take place on leads you create in this period. John Keells Properties will then prepare your Exclusive channel partner contract. You become an Exclusive channel partner when the contract is signed.
NEXT STEP Look for a second email from us, "Welcome to the John Keells Properties Partner Portal". It has your username and a link to set your password. If you cannot find it, check your spam folder.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
